title: Sport model came from an underwater archaeological dig found by the Navy
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Sport model came from an underwater archaeological dig found by the Navy, about before 1989 at unspecified body of water, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: from what Barry said, that was an archaeological dig, which by the way isn't in the desert, it's in the water.

And and Bob Lazar, it's interesting. So he did this first kind of press run and he talked about obviously element 115 reverse engineering a craft at S4 Area 51 and he recently there was a documentary that came out about him and he just did some other interviews and he goes actually I didn't mean archaeological dig. I meant this was a Navy find on the seafloor.
tellings.difference: Michels relays it second hand and frames it as Lazar recently correcting his earlier 'archaeological dig' wording to 'a Navy find on the seafloor'.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell Lazar's claim that the S4 craft came from an underwater find by the Navy, not from a desert dig.

as_told.title: Lazar: S4 craft was a Navy find on the seafloor

tellings.quote: Bob Lazar said that uh you know the craft that he worked on was from an archaeological dig on the ocean floor and it came from the Navy
tellings.difference: Told by the host crediting Lazar rather than by Lazar relaying Barry Castilio, and it says outright that the dig was the Navy's and on the ocean floor.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell Lazar's account that the craft he worked on came from an underwater archaeological dig tied to the Navy.

as_told.title: Lazar's craft came from Navy ocean floor dig
